lines.sung: El lobo rabioso la quiso morder
lines.en: The raging wolf tried to bite her,

lines.sung: mas Dios poderoso la supo defender
lines.en: but God almighty knew how to defend her;

lines.sung: quisole hazer que no pudiesse pecar
lines.en: he willed to make her so that she could not sin,

lines.sung: ni aun original esta virgen no tuviera
lines.en: nor would this virgin have even original sin.

lines.sung: Yo vi mil garçones que andavan cantando
lines.en: I saw a thousand young lads who went about singing,

lines.sung: por aquí bolando haziendo mil sones
lines.en: flying here and there, making a thousand sounds,

lines.sung: diziendo a gascones gloria sea en el çielo
lines.en: saying, "a gascones" (the sense is unclear), glory be in heaven

lines.sung: Y paz en el suelo pues Jesús nasçiera
lines.en: and peace on earth, for Jesus was born.
